name: Muhammad Sohaib
title: Full-Stack Developer | AI Automation Engineer
bio: Software engineer with 5+ years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Developer, currently pursuing a master's degree in Global Software Development at Hochschule Fulda (after a B.S. in Computer Science from the University of Sargodha). Before relocating to Germany, I worked at Astute Software in Lahore building projects for Italy-based clients; since moving, I've continued my career as a Full-Stack Developer at companies in Munich, Cologne, and Dortmund. My research interests are in Data Engineering and Big Data, and I've been exploring GenAI.
